tse_deployer.name: TSE Deployer
tse_deployer.restart_cmd: pm2 delete tse-deployer || true; pm2 start ../../server.js --name tse-deployer

tse_lead_finder.name: TSE Lead Finder
tse_lead_finder.build_cmd: npm run build && cd server && npm install
tse_lead_finder.restart_cmd: rm -rf ../../dist && cp -r dist ../../dist && rm -rf ../../server && cp -r server ../../server && cp version.json ../../version.json || true; pm2 delete tse-lead-finder-api || true; pm2 start ../../server/server.js --name tse-lead-finder-api
